title: A trip together
genre: 社群宣傳片 / 第一人稱約會
source: Lines are copied from ai-companion backend/app/activities (outings.py, choice_lines, closing_lines); a change there is not picked up here. The lines are spoken by the character (H3 dialogue), not burned in as subtitles (promo.subtitles = false). The place is a look, not a claim: Japanese coast is only the setting, and no shot shows readable signs. The static-subject constraint is on the shots where she only stands or sits (asked for after the earlier promos drifted).
